visitedPages.title: Know more about our College, Colleges in Madurai for Engineering
visitedPages.text: Know more about our College, Colleges in Madurai for Engineering --> ABOUT US Solamalai College of Engineering is one of the top colleges in Madurai for engineering, formerly known as Raja College of Engineering and Technology, was established in 1995. In 2016, the college was acquired by the Solamalai Group, a prominent brand in Madurai with a history dating back to 1962 when it began as a single lorry operator. Over the years, the Solamalai Group has diversified its business operations across Tamil Nadu, engaging in various sectors such as FMCG distribution, C&F services, goods truck transportation, passenger services, infrastructure, and cinema exhibition. With a dedicated team of more than 1400 employees, they have made significant strides in these fields. Solamalai College of Engineering is an autonomous institution approved by AICTE and affiliated with Anna University, Chennai. The college offers seven undergraduate programs and four postgraduate programs. It achieved a 3.5-star rating in IIC 4.0 for the year 2021-2022 and was recognized in the "Promising" category under "Colleges/Institutes (Private/Self-financed)(Technical)" in the Atal Ranking of Institutions on Innovations Achievement (ARIIA) 2021 The college serves as the Nodal center for the BMW Skill Next Program and is an affiliated center for conducting the Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY). It also houses the MHRD-supported e-yantra Robotics Lab. Furthermore, Solamalai College of Engineering has been acknowledged by the Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation (TNSDC) for conducting skill development courses and by the Unnat Bharat Abhiyan (UBA) for contributing to rural development in various villages in Madurai District. The institution boasts skill training centers and Industry Collaborative Innovation units to nurture an innovation culture among students. As a result, they are confident that their students will become valuable assets contributing to the growth of the organizations they serve and the nation as a whole. LEADERSHIP Chairman Mr. V.S.P. Solamalai Pitchai B.Sc., a science graduate, well experienced in marketing and logistics. He has gained expertise in automobile industry, warehousing, distribution, transportation and human resource management and has won the recognition of both Multinational and Indian companies. New venture creation and establishment is his another area of expertise whereby contributing to the growth of the company. Mr. S.P. Anand B.E, M.B.A., a Computer Engineering graduate from PSG College of Technology, Coimbatore and a Post Graduate from Swinburne University, Australia has expertise in opportunity evaluation, new venture creation and strategy formulation. Further, he has technical expertise and experience to handle all information technology requirements of the group combined with logistics operations. He majorly focuses on the Retail and FMCG distribution business of the group. Executive Director Executive Director Mr. S.P. Aravind B.Arch., M.I.L.D., an Architecture graduate from Thiagarajar College of Engineering and an Interior Design Post Graduate from the renowned Domus Academy in Italy, has an international exposure and immense work experience. He majorly focuses on the Educational Institutions and Supply chain solutions business apart from handling the infrastructure developments and branding strategies for our group. Dr. Sheela Ramachandran Pro Chancellor of Atmiya University, Rajkot, Gujarat, former Vice - Chancellor of Avinashilingam Deemed University for Women, Coimbatore, Former Principal, PSG College of Arts And Science, Coimbatore. Chief Advisor MISSION, VISION & VALUES VISION To be a premier institute for higher education, nurturing youth and other stakeholders as global, socially responsible citizens through academic, technical & innovative excellence and inclusivity MISSION To create an ecosystem of academic, research & innovation and skilled learning To mentor and facilitate inclusive learners to acquire academic excellence and application To encourage a mindset of inquiry towards critical thinking and creativity To Up skill and encourage transformation of learners as lifelong learners and responsible change makers To promote the above through social immersion, community engagement, technical up gradation and industry institute interaction VALUES Excellence in Education Student Centeredness Professional Development Research and Innovation Integrity and Ethics MILESTONES Solamalai, a popular brand in Madurai has evolved since 1962 as a single lorry operator and now has diversified business operations throughout Tamilnadu with an annual turnover of 600 crore rupees marking footsteps in FMCG distribution, C&F services, Goods Truck, Passenger transportation, Cinema exhibition, Architecture and Education with an able team of more than 1500 employees.

visitedPages.title: Placement Assistance - Solamalai College, Madurai
visitedPages.text: Placement Assistance - Solamalai College, Madurai --> PLACEMENT About Placement Cell The placement cell is designed to function with a high degree of professionalism. The placement cell manages its activities by the support of staff coordinators and the effort of students and all Head of Departments. The cell provides almost instantaneous data to the corporate sector about the candidates available for consideration towards placement under the prescribed requirements. Placement Cell Activities Our placement cell always works with a dedicated work attitude to accomplish the mission of 100% placement. To fulfill the responsibility of Training and Placement Cell, they arrange and coordinate various programmes that will mould our students to meet the industry expectations in career building and turn to bring laurels to the parent institution. Training and Placement cell takes care of honing the minds of our students to face the competitive world with courage, confidence, and wisdom. Placement Cell Activities includes Organizing and coordinates the Campus Placement Program, to fulfill its commitment of a job to every aspirant. Organizing training sessions aiming at making the student community employable. Nurturing a cordial relationship with the Industries, invite them for Campus recruitment drives, organizing technical seminars, workshops, and other technical sessions. Industry personnel are invited periodically to enrich the knowledge base of our student community with the latest technological innovations and industry practices. Promotes career counseling through guidance lectures by suitable corporate representatives. Maintaining an updated database and job profile, recruitment pattern of the companies and thus helps each student analyze and prepare their mindset. The department has in its active file database of voluminous records of corporates. Helps every student define his/her career interest through individual expert counseling
